hooks.name: Security review of server changes
hooks.description: After server edits, makes the agent review the change against the security steering rules and add missing tests.

action.prompt: A file under apps/ecotrace-web/server was just changed. Check the change against .kiro/steering/security.md: every new or changed endpoint must be authenticated or explicitly public and stateless, validate its input, cap sizes, never use child_process/eval, never leak stack traces, and must have a matching test in tests/server.security.test.ts. If anything is missing, fix it and add the test before continuing.
